text:
Priya (Product): small UX tidying ask from compliance: users are confused where 'Region' and 'Key owner' live. Do we surface Region site-wide or keep it inside Data Protection? mock: https://rwd.example/s/protect-v3 :thinking:
Noah (Design): site-wide pill increases discoverability. downside: header real-estate. alternative: compact header pill for Region + full details inside the Data Protection card.
Sam (Frontend): if Region is global we need to fetch region metadata on more routes. can lazy-load but that causes content shift. we could render a placeholder then hydrate.
Rita (A11y): if the pill moves to header, ensure its associated with the Data Protection region via aria-describedby. screen readers must hear context: "Region: US-West. Related: Data protection settings."
Priya (Product): proposal: header shows compact "Region: US-West" pill (tooltip: "Primary storage region for this account"). Data Protection card shows: "Encryption: Managed key (AcmeCorp)  Manage" so ownership stays contextual.
Noah (Design): layout idea for small widths: stack region pill above heading, then show a single-line key row. mock note: use secondary text for the timezone in audit rows.
Sam (Frontend): audit logs: support asked for local timezone + UTC. backend currently stores UTC. plan: show local time in the UI with a hover showing UTC. Export: include both columns: timestamp_local, timestamp_utc.
Priya (Product): agree. microcopy decisions: retention tooltip -> "Default retention: 30 days (account policy may override)"; encrypt help -> "Managed keys are stored by Redwood. To use your own key (BYOK), click Manage."
Rita (A11y): a11y checklist: tooltips must be keyboard-focusable buttons with aria-expanded; help popovers should set focus into the popover; encryption changes announced with aria-live polite: "Encryption set to Managed key". Export dialog must read column headers before download.
Sam (Frontend): I'll open tickets: RW-4201 (UI: header region pill + inline key owner), RW-4202 (copy + tooltip + aria), RW-4203 (audit export: add UTC column and update CSV headers).
ci-bot: deploy window scheduled: 2025-08-04 01:00 UTC for non-breaking UI/copy updates. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Product): thanks all  I'll add the approved copy to the style guide and ping docs for a KB update about the new CSV schema. :memo:
